notes: The team channel of a small software company over three working days: a release, a billing migration, a performance budget, hiring and an office move, with the files they share as cards, one of no topic, and chatter.

messages.text: morning! coffee machine on 3 is fixed
Release 4.2 goes out Thursday. I put the checklist in the shared drive, please tick your items there.
is the mobile build part of 4.2 or does it ship separately?
separately, next week
Billing migration: we move the first 50 accounts to the new invoicing provider on Friday. Plan doc is up.
do we freeze plan changes for those accounts during the move?
yes, from Thursday evening until Monday
The search page is at 2.8s p95 on the staging dataset. Our budget says 1.5s.
Office move: facilities sent the floor plan for the new space, desks are assigned by team.
Release 4.2: the feature flag for bulk edit stays off until support has docs.
anyone up for the climbing gym tonight?
Search p95 down to 2.1s after adding the index on bookings.start_at. Still over the budget.
is the remaining time in the query or in rendering?
about half rendering, the result cards re-render on every keystroke
Hiring: we have three onsite loops for the backend role next week. The interview rubric is in the drive, please read it before your slot.
Billing migration dry run on staging went through, 48 of 50 accounts matched. Two have prorated credits the new provider rounds differently.
can we just pay out the rounding difference?
finance says yes, under a dollar each
Release 4.2 is blocked on the flaky checkout test, I am looking at it.
Office move is the 9th. Pack your desk into the crates by the 8th at noon.
lunch order for tomorrow is in the usual sheet
Release 4.2: the checkout test was a timezone bug in the fixture. Fixed, release is back on for Thursday.
Search p95 at 1.4s with debounced rendering. Under budget on staging; will check production numbers next week.
Billing migration starts Friday 8:00. I will post in here when each batch of ten is done.
Hiring: the second onsite moved to Wednesday afternoon, rubric unchanged.
Office move: the new space has no parking for bikes yet, facilities are on it.
happy Wednesday, cake in the kitchen

cards.title: Release 4.2 checklist
cards.text: Checklist for release 4.2: freeze the branch Tuesday, run the full test suite, QA sign-off on checkout and bulk edit, support docs for bulk edit before its flag is turned on, release notes, deploy Thursday morning.

cards.title: Billing migration plan
cards.text: Plan for moving accounts to the new invoicing provider: a staging dry run, plan changes frozen for the accounts moved, batches of ten starting with fifty accounts, reconciliation of prorated credits, rollback by re-pointing the account to the old provider.

cards.title: New office floor plan
cards.text: Floor plan of the new office on the 4th floor: desks grouped by team, two meeting rooms, a kitchen, crates for packing provided by facilities.

cards.title: Backend interview rubric
cards.text: Rubric for the backend onsite: system design, debugging a failing service, code review, and a values conversation, each scored from one to four with written evidence.

cards.title: Holiday calendar
cards.text: The company's public holidays for next year, by country, and the rule for swapping a holiday.
